book.name: 1 CORINTHIANS
book.title: Paul CORINTH ep Tuptsiwni’yuṅqamuy amumi mohti Pēniata

content: The Message about Christ on the Cross
Pu nūu, itupkomu, ura nu umumi pítuhqe, lavayhtuwit, pu wuwantuwit ayo yukut, okiwhink̇aṅw umuy God tunatyayat āawna.
Nu umumum yank̇aṅw yan na’qala: Pas Jesus Christ nahoylehtsit ep nīniwhqat put‐sa tuwi’taniqeyu, qa hihta pīwu.
Nihqe nu umuhpa’ hinmak̇aṅw, pas qaöqálaniṅwu; hin unaṅway’k̇aṅw, pas tururutima.
Ura nu lavayit yuaataqe, sen tūaawnaqe tuhislavayit qa akw yuaata. Pi tuhislavayi pay sinmuy amuhpiy’o. Noqw nu qa pan yuaatat, Hikwsit öqalayat akw umuy tuptsiwna.
Noqw yan umuhtuptsiwni qa sinot wuwantuwiyat ep wunut, pas God öqalayat ep wunu.
Pay as pi itam aṅ tukwsiwyuṅqamuy amuhpa’ pas wuwantuwit yuaatota. Noqw pam wuwantuwi qa yep qatsit ahpiy’o, piw qa yep qatsit ep mohpeqyaqamuy amuhpiy’o. Pi puma tūwayawisa.
Itam pi God wuwantuwiyat tupkiwtaṅwuqat yuaatota, it’a: God hisatṅahaqaqw itamuy pas momi óyaniqey pasiwna.
Noqw yep qatsit ep moṅw’iwyuṅqam qa haqawa it navoti’ta. Kurs puma put navoti’yuṅwe’, soon Tutuyqawhqat lolmat tālawṅway’taqat nahoylehtsit aw muayani.
Noqw God hihta qaöwíhintaqat put aw unaṅway’yuṅqamuy amuṅem na’sasta. Noqw qa hak put pantaqat posiy akw aw yori, pu piw naqvuy akw put qa navota, pu piw qa hisat unaṅwmiq paki.
Nīk̇aṅw God Hikwsiy ahpiy itamumi put mahtakna. Pi Hikwsi sohsok hihta aṅ purima, hikis God suyan unaṅwtalwuwniyat pas qa mātsiwtaqata.
Puyaw hak sino sukw sinot unaṅwayat aw navoti’ta? Pay pas nāp hikwsiat ahsonvenihqa put navoti’ta. Noqw pan piw qa hak sino God unaṅwayat aw navoti’ta, pas put Hikwsiat‐saa.
Noqw pi it Hikwsit itam makiwyaqw pam qa yep qatsit ahpiynit God ahpiy’o. Noqw yan itam God itamuy hihta paysoq máqahqat mātsi’yuṅwa.

Nihqe itam put pantaqat piw yuaatota. Itam hihta yuaatotaqe, sinot wuwantuwiyat qa ahpiy put tutuqayya; noqw pay Qahováriwtaqa Hikwsi itamuy put tutuqaynaqw, itam Hikwsit aṅ hinwisqamuy amumum yuaatotaqe, hīhihta Hikwsit aṅ qatsqat namimahtakintota.
Noqw i’ hak nāp tunatyay aṅ hinmaqa hihta God Hikwsiyat aṅqwnihqat pas qa ömahtaṅwu, putniqw pi pam an’eway’o. Noqw pam pas hikwsit ahpiy māmatsniwṅwuniqw, ōviy kurs hin pam put māmatsni.
Noqw pay i’ hak Hikwsit aṅ hinmaqa sohsok hihta aṅ tuwantima; noqw soon hak sino put aw tuwanlawni.
Puyaw hak Tutuyqawhqat tunatyayat mātsi’taqe put aw tutaplawni? Pi itam Christ wuwniyat pasiwyuṅwa.
